editorialNote: A dated continuation after the frozen M1 and native-head journals. The implementation cutoff is d2585f3, not a moving release. Later final-pack qualification and live promotion remain separate events. Technical audio checks are not independent listening.

opening: Different-colored heads are not enough when several chats speak in the same Hazel voice. The next slice adds actual speaker styles, not cosmetic pitch presets.
M1v2 and the native-head continuation stay frozen. This smaller volume records one new implementation milestone, with actual commit dates and a deliberately narrow evidence allowlist.
A screenshot is not a listening test
The plate is the real manager during isolated qualification. It shows named voices and ownership, not accepted pronunciation, perfect expressions or an audio-quality comparison.
mechanism: Standard-library metadata lists 28 English styles without loading a neural model. Explicit optional setup pins one INT8 model and a shared style bundle; runtime never downloads missing files.
A lazy CPU child reuses the same model across styles. Checked 24-kHz mono becomes the existing 16-kHz PCM, EQ and silence padding, then drives both selected-face motion and playback.
The manager reserves unused startup voices, including heads still preparing their controls. Later deliberate duplicates remain visible. Omitted CLI voice follows the actual current selection.
Failure is not a voice choice

Unsupported pitch/emphasis settings fail rather than pretending to work. A local synthesis failure never substitutes Hazel. Cancellation discards output but cannot instantly interrupt synchronous inference.
acceptance: 28 optional English Kokoro styles, existing Windows compatibility, distinct session defaults, visible provider limits, current-selection CLI behavior and explicit resource ownership.

98 CPU regressions, all 28 initial style syntheses, a final-allocator two-style resource probe and real Claire/Mark controls, motion, cancellation, CLI and owned cleanup. Audio is muted and never persisted.
The final all-style allocator run, this journal's rendering and the owned live-head update occur after the source cutoff. The v0.2.0 tag is not moved and no new release or PDF upload is implied.
Perceptual uniqueness of every pair, preferred voices, pronunciation, human articulation, multilingual use, instant synthesis and eight-head throughput remain unaccepted.

entries.title: Different chats should not all sound like Hazel
body: The owner asked for several entirely local voices and left the choice and implementation to the agent while away. Windows voice packs, maintained Piper, Kokoro and sherpa-onnx were compared using primary sources rather than generic best-engine rankings.

Kokoro's one-model, many-style packaging fits this slice without adding Torch, a GPU or a service. The optional pinned pack exposes 28 US/British English styles and retains Hazel, David and Zira on this machine. That is not 28 resident neural models or a promise that every voice is equally good.

Real Claire and Mark heads receive different defaults. Native controls visibly reset and disable unsupported pitch/emphasis while preserving speed and EQ. Actual local speech drives the existing face/audio clock; current-selection CLI requests, cancellation and ownership cleanup are exercised.
entries.mechanism: Metadata -> unused-voice reservation -> lazy CPU child -> selected style -> 24-to-16-kHz conversion -> shared motion/audio pipeline.
entries.failure: An API or setup failure must not quietly substitute another voice. The optional phonemizer/eSpeak licenses are GPL, not covered by the weights' Apache license.
entries.boundary: The real UI plate and PCM checks do not establish independent listening, subjective preference or phonetic accuracy.

figures.caption: Actual isolated manager: Claire uses Emma and Mark uses Bella. The rail still displays an asynchronous cancellation; the plate is not a claim of idle-state completion or listening acceptance.

entries.title: Measure the model, not its tiny launcher
body: The first resource probe returned only a few megabytes after neural synthesis. That was the Windows virtual-environment launcher, not the Python process doing inference. The receipt is retained with an explicit invalid-scope correction rather than turned into an impressive but false memory claim.

The corrected complete-worker-tree baseline measured 311.92 then 444.07 MiB private bytes after two styles. Disabling ONNX Runtime's CPU arena measured 190.05 then 189.97 MiB in that sequence. Cold/warm wall times of 17.517 and 7.119 seconds are not a speed improvement; the change trades retained workspaces for lower warm memory.

Exact handles confirm that the entire local worker tree exits when Windows synthesis resumes. A short idle sample uses no process CPU. These observations exclude the face engine, Windows worker, Chromium and manager, and do not become a whole-machine or multi-head guarantee.
entries.mechanism: Follow owned process ancestry, sum the relevant private bytes, and retain exact process handles to distinguish launcher exit from complete worker teardown.
entries.failure: Missing SystemDrive/ProgramData environment created a literal-path Windows cache under the checkout. The environment is corrected; generated evidence is retained under ignored qualification rather than committed.
entries.boundary: One bounded memory/idle sequence is not universal performance certification. Keep final-pack, live delivery and listening acceptance separate.
